qs.q: A 52-year-old woman is diagnosed with an invasive breast carcinoma that tests positive for human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2). Which of the following systemic therapies is most appropriate for her?
qs.e: HER2-positive tumours specifically respond to targeted therapy with trastuzumab. Tamoxifen and anastrozole are used for hormone receptor-positive tumours rather than HER2-positive ones.
